# Elm Park Winter Fair: Announcement

30 October 2026

Elm Park Residents' Association

The Elm Park Residents' Association will hold the Elm Park Winter Fair on Saturday 28 November 2026. Everyone is welcome, from toddlers to grandparents.

## At a glance

When: Sunday 28 November 2026, 10:00 to 15:00, rain or shine

Where: Elm Park Community Hall, main hall and garden

Who: residents of Elm Park and their families

## Programme

| Time | What |
| --- | --- |
| 09:30 | Doors open |
| 10:00–10:15 | Opening |
| 10:15–11:30 | Bake sale and craft stalls (garden) |
| 11:30–12:30 | Lunch and food stalls |
| 12:30–11:30 | Children's craft workshop (main hall) |
| 11:30–12:30 | Local bands on stage |
| 14:30–15:00 | Raffle draw and close |

## Children's craft workshop

Places in the workshop must be booked in advance, and there are 25 places. By 29 October, 28 children had already booked.

Booking deadline: Saturday 5 December 2026

## Charges (per family)

| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Craft workshop materials | £3 |
| Lunch tokens | £6 |
| Raffle tickets | £2 |
| Total | £12 |

Please pay on the day at the reception desk of Elm Park Community Centre.

## Contact

Elm Park Residents' Association office, Tel: 020 7946 0186 (weekdays 10:00 to 16:00)

There is no car park. Elm Park Community Hall is a three-minute walk from the Elm Park Green bus stop.

If it rains, the garden stalls move into the main hall. To check on the day whether the fair is going ahead, call the office on Tel: 020 7946 0168.
